scope.contract: Original immutable I-005 and s3 copy/paste/group rows. Internal session clipboard only, not the OS clipboard and not a new SQLite table. Copy is planning-only. Cut=validated payload + one LiftClips, clipboard updated only after success. Paste embeds the payload in one PasteClips command. Group/Ungroup are selection groups, not AV links. Link+selection closure is complete or the whole group is refused.
scope.admittedSubset: Same-project paste onto existing same-kind tracks, mode=reject only. Paste-at empty uses current sequence duration; otherwise snapped seconds. Overwrite, insert/ripple, new-track creation, cross-project paste/import/bake and OS clipboard are not opened. Admitted captions stay at absolute authored times and are not packaged; clip-local caption follow remains refused. Marker-bearing projects remain FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Local admission still allows at most one video + one audio + one caption track.
scope.preserved: Source time maps, effect curves (including remapped keyframe IDs), proxy/asset version references (no Blob copies), audio link offsets, and complete AV link groups. Transitions copy only when both ends are in the closure; cut shifts by the paste delta, handle durations are unchanged, trackId follows the destination map. Locks, collisions, negative starts, incomplete transition handles and unsupported marker/caption items refuse the whole group, never a subset of members.
scope.history: Each mutating action is one existing persistent command with snapshot undo/redo, save/reopen, archive fork (now remaps selectionGroups / selectionGroupId / memberClipIds) and AAC MP4 export. Session clipboard is cleared on close, openDemo, resource-fork and archive restore. No new persistence schema or fingerprint side branch.
scope.ui: Workbench Copy/Cut/Paste/Group/Ungroup plus paste-at field. Status states the internal-vs-OS boundary and admitted subset. UI tests jump the page ListView (key foundation-scroll) so drag-scrolling cannot steal checkbox selection via the pointer timeline surface.
